title: Detailed drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum shell (cylinder body) -->
  <rect x='20' y='35' width='60' height='45' rx='4' fill='#d94f2b'/>
  <!-- shell highlights / gradient bands -->
  <rect x='20' y='35' width='60' height='12' rx='4' fill='#f26b3a'/>
  <rect x='20' y='47' width='60' height='6' fill='#e05528'/>
  <rect x='20' y='65' width='60' height='6' fill='#c94222'/>
  <!-- drum shell shading on sides -->
  <rect x='20' y='35' width='8' height='45' rx='4' fill='#b83a1e'/>
  <rect x='72' y='35' width='8' height='45' rx='4' fill='#b83a1e'/>
  <!-- top drum head (oval) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='30' ry='12' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- drum head inner ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='24' ry='9' fill='#e8d4b0'/>
  <!-- center highlight on head -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='33' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#faf0dc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- metal rim around top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='30' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- metal rim bottom edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='30' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- tension rods / lugs (verticals) -->
  <line x1='27' y1='38' x2='27' y2='78' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='33' x2='36' y2='83' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='31' x2='45' y2='85' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='31' x2='55' y2='85' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='33' x2='64' y2='83' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='73' y1='38' x2='73' y2='78' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- lug details (small rectangles on rim) -->
  <rect x='24' y='37' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='33' y='32' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='42' y='30' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='52' y='30' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='61' y='32' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='70' y='37' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <!-- bottom lugs -->
  <rect x='24' y='75' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='33' y='78' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='42' y='80' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='52' y='80' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='61' y='78' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='70' y='75' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <!-- drumsticks crossed -->
  <line x1='12' y1='8' x2='42' y2='30' stroke='#e8b84b' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='88' y1='8' x2='58' y2='30' stroke='#e8b84b' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stick tips -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='4' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='4' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  <!-- stick handle ends -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='8' r='2.5' fill='#d4a030'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='8' r='2.5' fill='#d4a030'/>
  <!-- accent sound waves (cute detail) -->
  <path d='M 8 50 Q 3 55 8 60' fill='none' stroke='#ff9944' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 5 47 Q -2 55 5 63' fill='none' stroke='#ff9944' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 92 50 Q 97 55 92 60' fill='none' stroke='#ff9944' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 95 47 Q 102 55 95 63' fill='none' stroke='#ff9944' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
